WITH 
  cte_sum_comm AS (SELECT SAL, SUM(COMM) AS EXPR1 FROM EMP GROUP BY SAL),

  INNER JOIN cte_avg_comm t5 ON (t2.SAL = t5.SAL) OR (t2.SAL IS NULL AND t5.SAL IS NULL)
